violations.text:
Unwrapped single-service utensils not presented so that only the handles are touched.
Forks at customer coffee station

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
pasta salad (46F - Cold Holding)
In display case for 2.5 hours. Chef moved to rapid chill

Handwash sink used for purposes other than handwashing.
Used to store dirty spatula. Manager moved
Bowl or other container with no handle used to dispense food.

Unwashed fruits/vegetables stored with ready-to-eat food.
Cut watermelon with mangoes with stickers
Wet wiping cloth not stored in sanitizing solution between uses.

Required employee training expired for some employees. To order approved program food safety material, call DBPR contracted provider: Florida Restaurant and Lodging Association (SafeStaff) 866-372-7233.
